agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, June 20, 2017 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Mayor Waronek
d.
Roll Call
a.
Call Meeting to Order
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-o be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Adjourned Regular Meetings of May 17 & 22, 2017 and the Regular Meeting of June 6, 2017.
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Monthly Report for the Administrative Services Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7d
e.
Monthly Report for City Manager's Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7e
f.
Monthly Report for the Community Development Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7f
g.
Monthly Report for the Parks & Recreation Department
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7g
h.
Monthly Report for the Public Works Department
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7h
i.
April Treasurer Report
ACTION: That the April report be received and filed.
Item #7i
j.
Notice of Completion for Project 134 City Hall Standby Generator
ACTION: That the City Council: 1) accept the work performed by Global Power Inc. for Project 134 the purchase and installation of a standby generator at city hall; 2) authorize the Special Project Coordinator to sign the Notice of Completion (NOC) and release the 5% retention payment in the amount of $13,817.17 to Global Power Inc., 35 calendar days after recordation of the NOC by the County Recorder's Office contingent upon no claims being filed on the project and the contractor posting an acceptable warranty bond; and 3) authorize the City Clerk to file the NOC with the County Recorder's Office.
Item #7j
k.
Notice of Completion for construction of Teuchert Park
ACTION: That the City Council: 1) accept the work performed by Line Tech Contractors for the construction of Teuchert Park; 2) authorize the Public Works Director to sign the Notice of Completion (NOC) and release the 5% retention payment in the amount of $13,479.99 to Line Tech Contractors, 35 calendar days after recordation of the NOC by the County Recorder's Office contingent upon no claims being filed on the project and the contractor posting an acceptable warranty bond; and 3) authorize the City Clerk file the NOC with the County Recorder's Office.
Item #7k
l.
Authorization to enter into a Professional Services Agreement with HdL Companies for Sales Tax Management
ACTION: That the City Manager be authorized to sign an agreement with HdL Companies to provide sales tax and use tax audit, and information services.
Item #7l
m.
Aproval of an Ordinance amending Section 2-1.01 LMC to clarify that when scheduled City Council meetings fall on a legal holiday, the meeting shall be held on the next business day succeeding business day thereafter, which is not a holiday.
Ord No. 790 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, amending Section 2-101 of the Lomita Municipal Code to clarify that when scheduled City Council Meetings fall on a legal holiday, the meeting shall be held on the next succeeding business day thereafter, which is not a holiday. (First Reading)
Item #7m
n.
Approval of a resolution accepting the donation of a storage container and CERT (Community Emergency Response Team) supplies from Toyota Motor North America, Inc.
Res 2017-16 - A resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita approving and accepting the donation of a Community Emergency Response Team (CERT) storage container from Toyota Motor North America, Inc. to the City of Lomita.
ACTION: That the City Council adopt the resolution accepting the donation of a storage container and CERT supplies from Toyota Motor North America, Inc.
Item #7n
o.
Adoption of Financial Management Policies
ACTION: That the City Council adopt the eight attached resolutions establishing Financial Policies.
Res. 2017-17 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita establishing Financial Policies guiding revenue, expenditure, cash, investment and debt management, fund balance and reserve, inventory and physical assets, and accounting practices and processes.
Res. 2017-18 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita adopting a fixed assets policy.
Item #7o
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE DIRECTION REGARDING ALPR CAMERAS
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
ACTION: That the City Council review the information contained in the staff report and provide staff further direction.
Item #8
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
9.
PUBLIC HEARING - ADOPTION OF THE FISCAL YEAR 2017-2018 BUDGET
Presented by Administrative Services Director Kamada
ACTION: That the hearing be closed; and that the City Council adopt the five resolutions for the complete implementation of the Fiscal Year 2017-2017 budget.
Res. 2017-25 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita adopting the City budget for Fiscal Year commencing July 1, 2017 and ending June 30, 2018.
Item #9
10.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned to the Regular Meeting to be held on Tuesday, July 18, 2017, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA. NOTE: Since the scheduled July 4, 2017 Council meeting falls on a holiday, the Council has elected to cancel that meeting.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
